method: Verbatim original JSON extraction; expected outcomes are diagnostic proposals, not product replay results. No source video read, new inference, or original file writes.
extraction_rules: owned_observations come only from face_evidence.segments[:main_result_count] and retain original embeddings and fields.
Original source cut inventory is unioned with saved verified scene cut changes.
Only the matching original identity boundary, exact matching handoff, nearby output intervals/decision reasons, poses, owned faces and joint matches are included.
Joint match values are copied exactly; large model_candidates arrays are omitted.
No reconstituted matcher outcomes or averaged embeddings are used in this fixture.
